node.statement: The propagators of linearised fourth-derivative gravity (action I = ∫d⁴x [R^(1)_{μν}R^{(1)μν} - β(R^(1))²]) decompose into scalar, vector, and tensor sectors with no cross-terms. For β ≠ 1/3, the scalar propagators are ⟨ΦΦ⟩ = 3/(4k⁴) + 1/(2k²p²) + (1-2β)/[8(1-3β)p⁴], ⟨ψψ⟩ = (1-2β)/[8(1-3β)p⁴], ⟨Φψ⟩ = -1/(4k²p²) - (1-2β)/[8(1-3β)p⁴]; the vector propagator is ⟨V_iV_j⟩ = P^T_{ij}/(k²p²); and the tensor propagator is ⟨h^{TT}_{ij}h^{TT}_{kl}⟩ = 2Π^{TT}_{ijkl}/p⁴.
